name: Track Statistics
summary: Adds processed statistic scoreboards (prefix hc_) such as minutes played, elytra distance, swim distance and ores mined, intended for Hermitcraft-style leaderboards.

mechanics.title: Objectives
mechanics.description: hc_playTime (minutes, from play ticks / 1200), hc_elytraKm (elytra cm / 100000), hc_swimKm (swim cm / 100, so effectively metres), and per-ore mined counts (coal, diamond, emerald, redstone, lapis, iron, gold, copper with stone and deepslate variants summed) plus nether quartz and ancient debris, with a combined hc_MineOre total. Each has a matching '...Show' objective meant for display.

mechanics.title: Showing a leaderboard
mechanics.description: Nothing is displayed by default. Operators use /scoreboard objectives setdisplay, e.g. sidebar hc_playTimeShow.

getting_started: Operators run /scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar hc_MineOreShow (or another ...Show objective).
editor_notes: The elytra and swim divisors are inconsistent in the original code (km vs metres); document as-is. Server/admin oriented.
